claims.claim: A failed critical relay send stops the pass. The returned cursor sits before the failed row, so the next pass retries it.
Successful sends advance the cursor exactly as before.
/healthz autonomy_level reads the operator ledger at PAPER_LEDGER_PATH. A missing ledger reads manual-ticket and is not created.

unverified: Seat-cycle autonomy (SeatContext.autonomy_level) now also reads the operator level. This is intended but wider than the /healthz symptom. No existing test covers the seat-side change.
A permanently failing critical alert blocks every later relay row (head-of-line), and it is retried each tick. This is the fail-closed design; the operator must know it.
autonomy_level opens the operator database on each call. The cost is not measured.
